analysis: The trial executed successfully but the architectural hypothesis failed: pinned-host validation macro HR@10 was 0.6013 versus the supplied parent reference of 0.6275, a decrease of 0.0262. Category HR@10 was 0.650 Movies_and_TV, 0.640 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.415 Electronics, and 0.700 CDs_and_Vinyl, with 200 validation users each. Electronics declined from the supplied 0.425 reference to 0.415. Other parent category metrics were not supplied, so their changes cannot be established. Zero initialization preserved initial parent predictions, but learning the unrestricted direct latest-item projection did not improve validation generalization. Excessive latest-item influence is a possible explanation, not a demonstrated cause. The proposed 0.6375 was not achieved. This result argues against retaining this residual extension under the tested training configuration.
code_summary: Trained one independent LightGCN-based network per category with tied propagated item embeddings, relative-position history attention, a latest-item attention-query projection, a gated user/history fusion, and item scoring biases. Added a jointly trained, zero-initialized bias-free history_residual projection of the latest valid item after gated fusion; empty histories retain the graph user vector. Preserved supervised-edge graph masking, prefix sampling, objective, optimizer, seeds, and checkpoint selection. Diagnostics checked residual inputs, parent parity at zero initialization, finite gradients, empty-history behavior, and serialization. The generated predictor strictly restores exactly one selected checkpoint per category, including both latest-item projections, and preserves all four dataset routes. No ensemble or separately fitted auxiliary scorer was used.
